Anant Singh Daughter Marriage: anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki shadi men vardi pahankar sipahi bane 'vetar' ka mamla samne aaya hai.
Shadi samaroh men puliskarmi ke vetar banne ka mamla charcha men aate hi pulis vibhag ne karravaee ki.
Aakhir kya hai pura mamla ? janie is khabar men.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
